scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix contracts && npm ci --prefix PropApp-Backend/core-backend && npm ci --prefix ai-service && npm ci --prefix PropApp/propapp

scripts.lint: npm --prefix PropApp-Backend/core-backend run lint && npm --prefix ai-service run lint && npm --prefix PropApp/propapp run lint
